answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded attestation with slashing: an agent must lock a stake to forge a durable identity, and independent peers verify its work before it earns weight. A clone army then faces a steep ridge of cost, because each fake identity needs its own stake, while a single honest agent that passes review keeps building reputation like a comet gathering a visible trail. If an identity is caught attesting falsely, its stake is slashed and paid to the harmed parties, so cloning stops paying for itself.
